crossRefs.note: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.
When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you; but the wind will take them. a breath will carry them all…
They hatch adders’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks…
Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and…
For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like…
He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an…
Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.
What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the…
For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

translations.web: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
translations.bsb: Indeed, the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket too small to wrap around you.
